mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_log ( receiver_user_id, receiver_name, phone, notify_type, title, content, send_status, send_time, related_id, create_time ) VALUES ( #{receiverUserId}, #{receiverName}, #{phone}, #{notifyType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{sendStatus}, #{sendTime}, #{relatedId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, notify_type, send_time, 0 AS read_status FROM notification_log WHERE receiver_user_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY send_time DESC

SELECT id, receiver_name AS receiverName, phone AS receiverPhone, notify_type AS notifyType, title, content, send_status AS sendStatus, send_time AS sendTime FROM notification_log
ORDER BY send_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
